working_definition: Cluster named by the authors as photoreceptors (ninaC, trp, trpl) in the Davie 2018 adult brain atlas; taken at face value as photoreceptor cells, composed primarily of that type.
searches_performed: light-sensitive neuron (VFB term info: exact synonym photoreceptor cell)
justification: The authors identify this cluster as photoreceptors by the phototransduction markers ninaC, trp and trpl (Table S2 res-2.0 cluster 53; top Table S3 markers Arr1, Arr2, ninaE, inaC, inaD, Galphaq), i.e. the rhabdomeric phototransduction machinery. FBbt:00007251 'rhabdomeric photoreceptor cell' is the term for that type: a child of 'light-sensitive neuron' and parent of eye photoreceptor cell, ocellar retinula cell and eyelet photoreceptor cell. The authors name no finer subtype.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Sensory neuron that reacts to the presence of light.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of rhabdomeric photoreceptor cell; too broad - also covers non-rhabdomeric light-sensitive neurons.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Cholinergic, rhabdomeric photoreceptor cell of the eyelet (Yasuyama and Meinertzhagen, 1999). It expresses Rh6 and is green light-sensitive (Jean-Guillaume and Kumar, 2022). Its axon terminates in the accessory medulla (Helfrich-Forster et al., 2007). There are four of these cells per eyelet.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Specific photoreceptor subtype not named by the authors

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Photoreceptor cell of an adult ocellus. It expresses the violet-sensitive Rh2 (Jean-Guillaume and Kumar, 2022). Its axons target the corresponding ocellar ganglion (Caldwell et al., 2007).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Specific photoreceptor subtype not named by the authors

recommendation: Accept exact match to FBbt:00007251 rhabdomeric photoreceptor cell.
